shake up.meaning: Trộn mọi thứ trong một vật chứa bằng cách lắc mạnh.
shake up.example: Pour the ingredients into a container and shake them up.

shape up.meaning: Phát triển theo hướng tích cực.
shape up.example: Things are shaping up at work- everything's going well again.

shape up.meaning: Cải thiện để đạt được tiêu chuẩn có thể chấp nhận được.
shape up.example: If they don't start shaping up, they're going to lose their jobs.

shave off.example: He has shaved off his moustache and looks much younger.
He shaved a few thousand off the budget for the year.

shell out.meaning: Chi tiền cho việc gì đó, đặc biệt là khi bạn nghĩ nó quá đắt.
shell out.example: I had to shell out a hundred pounds on the dinner.

ship off.meaning: Gửi ai đó đi, thường là do một vấn đề.
ship off.example: They had to ship off the old furniture today.

ship out.meaning: Gửi hàng hóa đến một nơi.
ship out.example: We shipped the order out two days ago.
If you've finished your work, I'm ready to ship out.

shoot away.meaning: Rời đi đâu đó thật nhanh.
shoot away.example: He shot away as soon as the bell rang for the end of the lesson.

shoot back.example: I'm shooting back home to pick up some things I forgot to bring with me.

shoot for.example: I’m shooting for nothing less than the presidency.

shoot off.meaning: Rời đi khẩn trương và nhanh chóng.
shoot off.example: I'll have to shoot off as soon as the lesson finishes, otherwise I'll miss my train.

shoot out.meaning: Ra ngoài trong một thời gian ngắn.
shoot out.example: I will shoot out to the store for milk.

shoot up.example: paper. The share prices of internet companies have been shooting up lately.

shoot up.meaning: Tiêm chích ma túy tĩnh mạch.
shoot up.example: The heroin-user would shoot up in shop doorways.
The gangsters shot up the pub.
The young boy will shoot up very quickly this year.

shop around.meaning: Khảo giá để tìm giá, chất lượng tốt nhất, v.v.
shop around.example: If you shop around, you can find some real bargains for air tickets.

short out.example: The battery shorted out when it got wet.

shout down.meaning: Gây nhiều tiếng ồn để át tiếng ai đó.
shout down.example: His efforts to raise the issue were shouted down.

shout out.meaning: Nói to điều gì đó, thường là để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó.

show around.meaning: Đưa ai đó đi tham quan.
show around.example: The estate agent showed us around the house but we didn't like it much.

show in.meaning: Dẫn ai đó vào phòng làm việc hoặc phòng khác.
show in.example: The secretary showed me in to speak to the manager.

show off.meaning: Thể hiện để thu hút sự chú ý.
show off.example: The children were showing off and irritated me.

show off.meaning: Khoe khoang điều gì đó bạn tự hào.
show off.example: He wanted to show off his new sound system.

show off.meaning: Làm cho những phẩm chất của một thứ khác trở nên rõ ràng hơn.
show off.example: The shirt really showed off his new tie.

show out.meaning: Tiễn ai đó ra khỏi phòng hoặc tòa nhà.
show out.example: Her secretary showed me out after the interview.

show over.meaning: Dẫn ai đó đi xem quanh một địa điểm.
show over.example: He will show over the garden to his guests.

show round.meaning: Đưa ai đó đi tham quan một nơi.
show round.example: The guide showed them round the historic part of the city.

show through.meaning: Lộ ra (cảm xúc) mặc dù đã cố gắng che giấu.
show through.example: His anger showed through despite his smile.

show up.meaning: Xuất hiện hoặc đến một nơi nào đó.
show up.example: Very few showed up at the meeting.
The downturn in sales showed up in the company's accounts.

show up.meaning: Làm ai đó cảm thấy xấu hổ.
show up.example: He showed us up when he arrived drunk and started arguing.

shrug off.meaning: Bỏ qua điều gì đó, coi nó là không quan trọng hoặc không có hại.
shrug off.example: He shrugged off the criticism and carried on the same way.

shut away.meaning: Bỏ tù hoặc tước đi tự do của ai đó.
shut away.example: Many people have been shut away in psychiatric hospitals for disagreeing with the government.

shut down.meaning: Đóng cửa doanh nghiệp, cửa hàng, v.v.
shut down.example: The shop shut down when the out-of- town supermarket opened.
You must shut down your computer before leaving tonight.

shut in.meaning: Ngăn không cho ai đó rời đi.
shut in.example: Shut a computer down. I shut the cat in until it was time to go to the vet.

shut off.example: They shut the water off while they did the repairs.

shut out.example: You have to shut your feelings out to deal with it.

shut out.meaning: Không cho người chơi hoặc đội bóng ghi bàn.
shut out.example: The Dodgers shut out the Giants 3-0.

shut out of.meaning: Loại ai đó khỏi một hoạt động, v.v.
shut out of.example: He's been shut out of the discussions.

shut yourself away.example: She's shut herself away to revise for her exams.

shy away from.meaning: Tránh làm việc gì đó vì thiếu tự tin.
shy away from.example: Many learners shy away from using phrasal verbs.

shake a leg.example: Come on, we need to leave soon. Shake a leg!

shape up or ship out.meaning: thay đổi thái độ hoặc là nghỉ việc/cuốn gói ra đi
shape up or ship out.example: If you don’t start meeting deadlines, you’ll have to shape up or ship out.

sharp as a tack.meaning: cực kỳ thông minh, nhạy bén
sharp as a tack.example: Despite his age, Grandpa is still sharp as a tack.

ships passing in the night.meaning: người lướt qua đời nhau, tình cờ gặp gỡ rồi chia xa
ships passing in the night.example: We were like ships passing in the night, only meeting briefly before moving on.

shoestring budget.example: The project was completed on a shoestring budget but still turned out great.

shoot from the hip.meaning: nói thẳng thừng, phản ứng tức thời không suy nghĩ kỹ
shoot from the hip.example: He tends to shoot from the hip during meetings without considering the consequences.

shoot hoops.example: Let’s go to the park and shoot hoops this afternoon.

shoot off one's mouth.meaning: nói năng thiếu suy nghĩ, ba hoa
shoot off one's mouth.example: Don’t shoot off your mouth in the meeting, it’s better to listen first.

shoot the breeze.example: We spent the afternoon just shooting the breeze at the coffee shop.

shot in the arm.meaning: liều thuốc tinh thần, sự khích lệ
shot in the arm.example: The unexpected bonus at work was a real shot in the arm for our motivation.

shot in the dark.meaning: sự phỏng đoán, mò mẫm trong bóng tối
shot in the dark.example: It was a shot in the dark, but I managed to guess the correct password.

show of hands.meaning: biểu quyết bằng cách giơ tay
show of hands.example: Let's have a show of hands to see who agrees with the new proposal.

shop till you drop.meaning: Mua sắm thả ga đến kiệt sức.
shop till you drop.example: During the Black Friday sale, they went to the mall and shopped till they dropped.

shed light on.meaning: Làm sáng tỏ, làm rõ một vấn đề.
shed light on.example: Recent archaeological discoveries have shed light on how ancient civilizations lived.
